entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Elisa Frota Pessoa was a Brazilian experimental physicist. In 1942, she became one of the first women in Brazil to graduate with a degree in physics and was one of the founding members of the Centro Brasileiro de Pesquisas Físicas.
